decisions.reason: As an established German machinery maker we have already publicly backed and marketed this compact trommel for several years, and its apparent acceptance plus fit with our screening portfolio makes us more likely to continue than to withdraw it quickly.

Although the weaker 2019 website presence suggests softer traction, this multi-model mobile shredder line sits close to our core mobile processing business, so our prior development commitment and the possibility of temporary market hesitation favor keeping it for now.

The move from a mention in 2018 to a dedicated page in 2019 indicates rising commitment to this grinder line, and because it matches our stated direction in resource-saving mobile processing we would likely persist with it.

This stationary pre-shredder line shows the strongest visible commitment and concrete reference use, and because it is strategically central to tougher stationary recycling applications we would be very reluctant to drop it.
